messages:
maria: eval-bot just flagged a regression in the nightly run: promptset v4 -> ~6.2% coverage drop on reasoning_prompts compared to v3. rolled v4 last night as the promptset rebase. cc @devon @sam :eyes:

devon: ugh. can you paste the promptset diff and a few failing examples? also which model/quantization was used for the eval?

maria: running quick diff now. main change was some prompt rewrites (goal wording + fewer examples). diff snippet:
```diff
- Q: Explain step-by-step why the answer is 42.
+ Q: Summarize the rationale behind the answer (short).
```
Nightly eval used rwin-13b-qat (int4) in the hosted benchmark pool. eval-bot metrics:
```
- reasoning_prompts coverage: v3=0.942 -> v4=0.883
- avg F1: 0.86 -> 0.80
- flagged 24 failed queries (sample below)
```

eval-bot: nightly-eval/1762509800 status=regression scope=promptset/rebase metric=coverage delta=-0.059

sam: that wording change (Explain step-by-step -> Summarize) would explain fewer multi-step chains, so coverage dropping makes sense. Did we intentionally shorten the prompts for UX?

maria: product asked for terser prompts to reduce token usage. but the eval harness expects explicit chain-of-thought phrasing in this subset. sample failing case:
```
Prompt: "Q: Why is the sky blue?\nA:"
Model v3 output: "Because sunlight scatters in the atmosphere... step 1: ... step 2: ... conclusion..." (passes coverage)
Model v4 output: "Short: scattering of sunlight causes blue appearance." (fails coverage)
```

devon: ok. two paths: revert the prompt wording in promptset v4 for the reasoning group OR rebaseline the eval expectations to accept concise rationale. Which do we want?

rachel: from product POV, we wanted shorter UX, but not if it breaks quality baselines. propose: do a scoped rebaseline for reasoning_prompts only, but we need sign-off and a diffs PR that shows acceptance tests.

sam: agree with scoped rebaseline. we should also rerun with fp16 (non-quant) to ensure it isn't quantization interaction. if fp16 retains coverage, then quant profile needs tuning.

maria: action items:
- [ ] open PR with promptset v4 -> mark reasoning prompts as "concise" variant + add metadata tag (maria)
- [ ] run rerun nightly with rwin-13b-fp16 and rwin-13b-qat to compare (sam)
- [ ] produce a rebaseline PR for reasoning_prompts with new acceptability thresholds + sample passing generations (devon)
- [ ] get product + eng sign-off on rebaseline (rachel)

devon: I'll start the rebaseline PR. quick note: include a small diff summary in the PR description that lists which prompts changed (path + old text -> new text). that speeds reviews.

rachel: approved the approach. once PRs are up, I can coordinate the stakeholder review. :thumbsup:

maria: uploading failing examples and eval artifacts to the shared bucket now: gs://redwood-evals/1762509876/promptset-v4/ -- will link in PR. :link:

sam: also adding a short test in the nightly CI to detect promptset label changes (so future rebases get flagged with a required rationale).

devon: noted. tagging this thread in the PR. thanks all.

maria: thanks — will keep updates here as jobs finish. :hourglass:
